name: Tulsa County, OK
findings: Tulsa County has 2,838 nonprofit organizations. 1,020 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 784 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Tulsa County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few housing organizations list membership
observations.text: 5 housing organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 26 would.
